name: datadiff
description: Runs a SQL query or a data-processing function before and after a code change, and shows the row-level difference as a table (added/removed/changed rows) plus a chart of any numeric column whose total moved. Rebuilds the "before" state by swapping the query file or function file to a git ref, the same trick uidiff uses for screenshots. macOS-friendly, no npm dependencies; SQL needs snowsql on PATH. Use when reviewing a change to a query or transform function, or checking what a change to either actually did to the data.
